instruction: Download the image from "https://huggingface.co/datasets/xlangai/ubuntu_osworld_file_cache/resolve/main/multi_apps/3c8f201a-009d-4bbe-8b65-a6f8b35bb57f/kingbird.jpeg" and use GIMP to export it at 50% quality as "medium_quality.jpeg" on the Desktop with a file size under 300KB.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading image and exporting at reduced quality to achieve under 300KB file size. Using existing check_image_file_size metric from official GIMP metrics library.
